messages:
Sam K.: FYI ran the new rwd-v3.1-int4 onboard pass; small but consistent distributional drift on the longform-legal slice (KLD ~0.18 vs baseline).
Maya T.: Can you summarize impact?
Sam K.: Two things: (1) generation token-level KL between int4 and fp16 up at 0.18 median on that slice (baseline 0.05). (2) Rouge-L down ~2.2 points for long summaries (>1200 tokens). Latency p99 unaffected.
Omar V.: Interesting. Our gating rules trigger an automatic hold if KLD > 0.15 AND any fidelity metric drop >1.5 pts on a critical slice for 15m. This meets KLD but hovers close on rouge.
Jin H.: We also have a soft-pause path: if KLD >0.12 but <0.25 we can block full promote and run targeted kernel/codec variants. Suggest we run three quick variants: A) per-channel-int4 (baseline), B) int4 + tokenizer-fix (merge space-handling), C) int4 + revised quant-matrix (alt calibr).
Sam K.: I'll enqueue a stratified 6k shadow A/B across longform-legal and longform-finance (risk slices) with sample logging. Pinning seeds to ensure determinism.
rollout-bot: Run queued: id=6600001111-AB, targets=6000, slices=[longform-legal,longform-finance], start=now
Maya T.: Proposal for decision logic: if (KLD_median < 0.12 AND RougeL_delta > -1.0) -> promote soft 5% for 30m; else if (KLD_median >0.2 OR RougeL_delta <= -2.5) -> trigger auto-fallback to rwd-v3.1-fp16 and pin route. Otherwise hold and run triage.
Omar V.: Add hysteresis: require condition to hold across 2 sampling windows (10m each) to avoid noisy flip. Also add slice-priority: legal>finance>general; legal breaches force immediate action.
metrics-bot: interim aggregates every 10m. first agg in ~8m.
Sam K.: Local check I used before queuing:
```
# pseudo-eval
variants = ["perch-int4","tokfix-int4","altcal-int4"]
res = run_shadow(variants, n=6000, stratify=["slice","length>1200"]) 
pass = (res.kld.median < 0.12 and res.rougeL.delta > -1.0)
if pass:
    action = "soft_promote"
else:
    if res.kld.median > 0.2 or res.rougeL.delta <= -2.5:
        action = "auto_fallback"
    else:
        action = "hold_and_triage"
```
Jin H.: Can ops prepare the fallback automation: flip traffic back to fp16, pin stable tag, and create a triage ticket with snapshots of token deltas and sample failures. Use rollout playbook v2.
Maya T.: I'll own communications. If we need a rollback we'll want an incident banner and an owner from model-onboard.
Sam K.: Noted. I'll attach run artifacts and representative failing pairs to the run link when available.
rollout-bot: run status updated: 6000/6000 processed, results https://dash.internal/runs/6600001111-AB (artifacts uploaded)
metrics-bot: final aggregates posted: longform-legal KLD=0.203 median, RougeL delta=-2.6, longform-finance KLD=0.09, RougeL delta=-0.8
Maya T.: Based on the decision logic, longform-legal crosses hard thresholds -> auto-fallback should run.
Omar V.: Executing auto-fallback: flipping route to rwd-v3.1-fp16 and pinning stable tag. Also kicking off kernel-compat triage for tokenizer and quant calibr.
rollout-bot: auto-fallback executed, traffic flipped to rwd-v3.1-fp16, stable tag pinned. Incident ticket created: #INC-6600001111
Sam K.: Thanks. I'll start the archive for artifacts and begin a deeper debug on tokenizer rounding + quant scale drift.
Jin H.: After triage, let's consider a fix candidate: tokenizer-space-normalize + re-calibration; re-run small validation and push a canary only to finance slice first.
Maya T.: Agreed. Closing loop here; we'll post updates in the incident ticket.
